notes.title: Tile Town - 'Endless Replayability Fest' Broadcast
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce that Tile Town is taking part in the Steam Endless Replayability Fest! During the event there will be a broadcast of the gameplay and you'll be able to get the game with a 50% discount. After all, hexagons are bestagons!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43015805/5a0005c5d190c6e0e5b1df9a07dfb55fe2e643bb.png[/img]

notes.title: Badges and trading cards are here!
notes.content:
You can now collect brand new Tile Town Steam trading cards, create 5+1 levels of badges and get 6 emoticons and 3 profile backgrounds. Start by playing the game or visit the community market. Huzzah!

notes.title: 'Hold tile' update
notes.content:
[h2]Update notes:[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Feature added:[/b] Hold tile (Default key: X) - A requested feature to keep a tile aside for later use has been added. This introduces a bit more strategical thinking into the game. How it works: You may use a Swap token to "hold" (set aside) the current tile temporarily. Upon retrieval the held tile will replace the current tile. You may only hold one tile at a time and must retrieve the held one before attempting to hold a new one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43015805/621558d3a95e3015ecbe667eb79b11eed190e588.jpg[/img]


[*][b]Gamepad input change:[/b] Query mode moved to Left shoulder button; Right face button (B) is now used for the "Hold tile" function.
[*][b]Bug fix:[/b] Swap tile button not showing as available in the last step of the tutorial.
[*][b]UI fix:[/b] Swap tile button (and now the Hold tile button as well) now have a "disabled" look when unavailable to use.
[/list]

[i]-> If you experience any technical issues with the game after an update, try restarting or reinstalling the game. If this doesn't fix the problem, or if you find any other bugs, please let me know in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2164780/discussions/]community discussions[/url] (you can use the link in the Credits menu or click on "View discussions" on the Tile Town store page on Steam). Thanks & enjoy![/i]

notes.title: Villager update
notes.content:
[h2]Update notes:[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Villager update:[/b] Villager meshes and animations completely overhauled; they now also try to avoid each other when walking close-by; footstep sounds added.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/q971461/update-villagers.jpg[/img]

[*][b]Feature added:[/b] 1st person mode movement overhauled; added collision with buildings.
[*][b]Feature added:[/b] A requested feature - [b]query mode with scores for other tiles[/b], not just the one being placed - has been added. You can access it by clicking the little hexagon icon in the top right to show currently unlocked tiles and hovering over the tile pictures.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/K9sDcKK/update-query.jpg[/img]

[*][b]Visual bug fix:[/b] Near-camera object clipping in 1st person mode fixed.
[*][b]Audio bug fix:[/b] You can now hear the sea sounds properly in 1st person mode.
[*][b]Bug fix:[/b] "Villagers disappear when zoomed out" sometimes didn't work properly, now fixed.
[*][b]Controls change:[/b] Mouse wheel no longer changes the 1st person movement speed; Shift is now used as a "running" button instead.
[*][b]Visual tweak:[/b] 1st person mode FOV slightly increased.
[*][b]Visual tweak:[/b] Slightly improved shadow quality over distance.
[*][b]Visual tweak:[/b] Orchard fruit trees now have a different texture on the fruits.
[*][b]Tile tweak:[/b] Farm tile now has a new variation with chickens.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/4SPs5CM/update-chickens.jpg[/img]

[*][b]Game math:[/b] Blacksmith now gives 10 more points to Butcher; Market now gives 20 less points to Butcher; Mountains and Forests now give 10 more points to Shrine; Church and Shrine now have a slightly higher chance to appear; School, Fisherman and Lighthouse now have a slightly lower chance to appear.
[*][b]Settings:[/b] VSync is now On by default for new players.
[/list]

[i]-> If you experience any technical issues with the game after an update, try restarting or reinstalling the game. If this doesn't fix the problem, or if you find any other bugs, please let me know in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2164780/discussions/]community discussions[/url] (you can use the link in the Credits menu). Thanks & enjoy![/i]

notes.title: v1.0 - Full release
notes.content:
[h2]After 9 months (how fitting) and a lot of smaller and bigger updates, Tile Town is now leaving Early Access![/h2]

Thanks to everyone for support and interest in this little game.

[list]
[*]With the full release also comes a change in pricing to reflect the current state of the game.
[*]The game will continue to receive updates, although less often and less regularly.
[*]Leaderboards are staying up and will not be wiped.
[/list]

Cheers!

notes.title: UI & language update
notes.content:
[h2]Update notes:[/h2]

[b]- UI update:[/b] Complete UI design overhaul! The game UI just got a completely new feel and look. Everything is a bit more nicer to look at, easier to click on, and fits more nicely with the visual style of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43015805/be573d0856d7403514213ca8110e6401dd8e1d4e.png[/img]

[b]- Feature added:[/b] Control remapping! You can now bind your own keys to almost all actions. (Note: For now you can only remap keyboard controls. Gamepad controls are not yet remappable. However there is now a new button in the Options menu which shows you gamepad controls.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43015805/37cd92baf518038bbeccdfeed8f1fbda0551031d.png[/img]

[b]- Localization:[/b] More languages! Tile Town is no longer available in just English - select your language through a new language selection option in the Options menu. Currently there is English, French, German, Chinese and Czech available. More languages are planned for future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43015805/cc4cabf5e1065556e99ecff00d2d48d96647d197.png[/img]

[b]- Feature added:[/b] Map overview! You can now zoom out with [F] to see the entire map with highlighted free spots.
[b]- Feature added:[/b] Cloud saves! Your save file is now on the Steam Cloud.
[b]- UI update:[/b] "Controls" pop-up menu and the corresponding button have been removed. This section now lives directly in the Options menu.
[b]- Feature added:[/b] You can now hide the "Game over" window to have a better view of your finished town before you decide to move on.
[b]- Visual tweak:[/b] Golden double score spot is now shinier & more visible.
[b]- Visual tweak:[/b] New main menu scene to keep things fresh.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43015805/4ae6fcca60833047438a4d08d55e0d900d87f523.png[/img]

[b]- Bug fix:[/b] Fixed a bug where you could swap the tile while in 1st person mode.

[i]-> Please note that translations might not be final. The German and Chinese translations are mostly done with an AI translating service so it might (and probably will) contain some errors. If you find a translation error and you wish to help correct it, please reach out to me via one of the social links (available in the game's Credits menu) or in the community discussions. Thanks!

-> Your game might crash the first time you try to launch it after this update because of save file compatibility. This is okay and should fix itself and run properly the next time you launch the game (your save file will not be lost). Sorry for the inconvenience.

-> If after the update your controls don't work, or are not set at all, click the "Reset default" button next to the Controls option. If you experience any other technical issues with the game after an update, try reinstalling the game. If this doesn't fix the problem, or if you find any other bugs, please let me know in the community discussions (you can use the link in the Credits menu). Thanks & enjoy![/i]

notes.title: Beach update
notes.content:
[h2]Update notes:[/h2]

[b]- Visual feature added:[/b] Beaches and seawalls! All tiles now smoothly descent into the sea via a beach with randomized features, and all ploppables now create a stone wall (with possible wooden piers as well) if placed next to water. Aesthetic!
[b]- Audio feature added:[/b] Building sound effects! Some buildings will now occasionally make a short sound effect consistent with their function, adding to the rural atmosphere of the game.
[b]- Audio feature added:[/b] Sea now makes a... well, sea sounds (and seagulls).
[b]- Visual tweak:[/b] Lighting cubemap changed - the lighting is now a little bit different and shadows are a bit brighter. Darkest shadows are now not almost completely black as before, making for a more balanced and pleasant image overall.
[b]- Visual tweak:[/b] Sky overhaul - new clouds & sun disc added (only visible in 1st person view, obviously).
[b]- Visual tweak:[/b] Lens flare effect added.
[b]- Visual tweak:[/b] Bloom intensity lowered.
[b]- Visual tweak:[/b] Sea is now a bit more blue.
[b]- Building change:[/b] Lighthouse can now be placed anywhere.
[b]- Building variations added:[/b] Monument can now appear in one of three (or perhaps four...) different variations.
[b]- Visual bug fix:[/b] 2x score off-map indicator now rotates properly with camera rotation.

[i]If you experience any technical issues with the game after an update, try reinstalling the game. If this doesn't fix the problem, or if you find any other bugs, please let me know in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2164780/discussions]community discussions[/url] (you can use the link in the Credits menu). Thanks & enjoy![/i]

notes.title: Procedural island update
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43015805/a9e4a04fe269aa2ec3fbb73e0b31ecd09d285960.jpg[/img]

[h2]Update notes:[/h2]

[b]- Feature added:[/b] Procedural levels are back! If you reach a total score of at least 150,000 points, you will unlock a new level, which is a procedurally generated island. Everytime you restart, you will get a new, random island (just like in the old times of Tile Town...:). So in order to beat your high score, you will now need a bit of luck as well as skill.
[b]- New ploppable tile:[/b] Lighthouse! Likes to be near the sea (duh) and rocks.
[b]- Optimization:[/b] Minor performance and visual optimizations.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43015805/f2cc86badc06d7b1346a5ef2b4debeaf45b85efe.jpg[/img]

[i]This update will [u]not[/u] delete your save file or your high scores, and if you already have 150,000 total score you will have access to the new level automatically. Yay! If this doesn't work for some reason, or you find any other bug or issue, please visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2164780/discussions/][b]community discussions[/b][/url] on Steam and report it there. Thank you & have fun![/i]

notes.title: Leaderboards update
notes.content:
[h2]Update notes:[/h2]

[b]- Core feature added:[/b] Online leaderboards! Your high scores (for each level and the total score) are now automatically saved to the Steam leaderboards and you can see your global rank next to each high score. Leaderboards are also accessible from the Steam community: https://steamcommunity.com/stats/2164780/leaderboards
[b]- Feature added:[/b] Interactive tutorial! "How to" button has been removed from the UI and instead the game now features an interactive tutorial level that guides you through the basics of the gameplay.
[b]- Feature added:[/b] Partial controller support (the game itself is now playable with a controller, but the UI and menus don't work properly yet; this feature is experimental at the moment and will be properly fixed in future updates).
[b]- Steam achievements:[/b] 4 new Steam achievements have been added!
[b]- Steam achievements:[/b] Names of most achievements have been modified
[b]- Feature removed:[/b] "Reset game and high scores" button in main menu removed (it served mostly debug purposes and would now clash with the online leaderboards). RIP.
[b]- Game math:[/b] When swapping a tile, you can no longer receive the same tile you just had - it's now bound to always be different.
[b]- Game math:[/b] Raised score requirements to unlock new levels (the game was too easy). This will also reset your save file... sorry!
[b]- Bug fix:[/b] Biome icon no longer shows up in the main menu after restarting the game.
[b]- Visual feature added:[/b] Current tile now slowly floats up and down.
[b]- Visuak feature added:[/b] Villagers' clothes color variety increased.
[b]- UI update:[/b] Changed design of the logo in main menu (also it's now clickable, just for fun... or is it?).

[i]Please note that the online leaderboards are just experimental at this point in Early Access and might sometimes not work properly, or get reset at some time. If you find any issues with them (or any other bug), please let me know in the community discussions (you can use the link in the Credits menu). Also please be aware that during early access most of the updates will reset your existing game, your settings and your save file. This is to make sure your save file is fully compatible with the newest version of the game. Sorry about that! If you experience any technical issues with the game after an update, try reinstalling the game.[/i]

notes.title: Water update
notes.content:
[b]Water & levels are here! The game has been significantly changed and many new optimizations and improvements have been made.[/b]

[img]https://iili.io/HRmJsNs.jpg[/img]

Update notes:
- Core gameplay changed: Levels! Instead of playing on a big randomly generated rectangular map, Tile Town now features a variety of unlockable levels with custom-made maps. Build up the islands and get enough score to unlock new levels!
- Core feature changed: Instead of one board with your top 10 high scores, high scores are now saved individually for each level
- New natural tile: Water! Some tiles now like/dislike being next to water.
- New ploppable tile: Fisherman 
- Game math: Amount of starter tiles changed; overhauled math for batch score requirements
- Game math: Some tile scores and stages in which tiles become unlocked have been modified
- Audio update: 2 new tracks added to background music (now 5 in total)
- Optimization: CPU and memory performance optimization
- Visual tweak: Bloom and ambient occlusion added; slight color correction
- Visual tweak: Camera now has slightly larger FOV
- Visual tweak: Slightly improved ground texture
- Visual tweak: Improved quality of tile thumbnail pictures
- Feature added: Developer social media buttons and feedback/bug report link added to Credits

[img]https://iili.io/HRmdjql.jpg[/img]

Please note that during early access most of the updates will reset your existing game, your settings and your save file. This is to make sure your save file is fully compatible with the newest version of the game. Sorry about that! If you experience any technical issues with the game after an update, try reinstalling the game.

notes.title: Update to v0.9.7 - Tile unlocking!
notes.content:

- Feature added: Tile unlocking! One of the most requested features has been added. You now start with only basic tiles and as you obtain new batches, you unlock new tiles that are then added into the random rotation.

[img]https://iili.io/ymoH5x.jpg[/img]

- Game math: You now start with 15 tiles instead of 10
- Game math: Tweaked math for batch score requirements
- Feature added: "What's new" button in the menu to easily access update notes straight from the game

Please note that during early access most of the updates will reset your existing game, your settings and your save file. This is to make sure your save file is fully compatible with the newest version of the game. Sorry about that! If you experience any technical issues with the game after an update, try reinstalling the game.
